attribution.text: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
attribution.source: nasa-gibs/gibs-api-docs docs/index.md, 'Data Use Guidance and Acknowledgements' (published at https://nasa-gibs.github.io/gibs-api-docs/), commit afb15814aee74b09e672466adb731b2e34d51d8b, read 2026-10-15
attribution.layer_credit: Layer titles are GIBS's own (layer-metadata/v1.0). GIBS publishes no credit line for GeoColor's producer; none is added here.

frame_rule: frame_utc is the newest 10-minute slot whose z0 tile GIBS served as a PNG of that time (a 200, and layer-time-actual equal to the slot where GIBS sends it), probed down from now; GIBS's `default` time, its DescribeDomains and its capabilities <Default> are never used (recon d091737 §1: each lagged or led the tiles). age_min is at probed_utc.
recent_rule: recent_present lists the frame and every present slot among the 11 slots below it, newest first; recent_unknown the slots whose answer was an error. A slot in neither was absent.
basin_rule: East for al, West for ep and cp

not_served.default_time: GIBS's `default` time is never bound: it served frames 20-60 minutes older than the newest present, by layer and minute (recon d091737 §1).
